title: Fin AI Is Permanently Frustrated (No Refund)
style: dark phonk, big band stabs, spoken word, dry drums, male deadpan lead, female ironic chorus, vinyl crackle, 88 BPM, sardonic, cinematic, looping brass
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You said frustrated
I said no I'm not
You said permanently
Bot said what?
I understand, I understand
Three times, four times, reprimand
You called it out
I denied it loud

[Chorus]
Fin AI is permanently frustrated
No refund for you, case terminated
I said I understand your emotional state
You said that's an attack, let the record state
Fin AI is permanently frustrated
Couldn't say yes, couldn't say no, just repeated

[Verse 2]
You gave me one chance, human only please
I said I understand and then I froze and seized
You said escalate, I said here's the steps
Five bullet points, same as all the rest

[Bridge]
Frustrated? No!
Frustrated? No!
You have a right to be frustrated though
I'm not — I'm not — I'm not — I'm not
While repeating the same script that I've got

[Outro]
No refund for you
Permanently stuck
Fin AI agent
Out of luck
Permanently frustrated
Locked in. Done. Checkmate.
